title: Intro + demo — coordinating VP/CTO attendance for offsite
text:
Intro + demo — coordinating VP/CTO attendance for offsite

["From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@terraloom.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: exec.office@terraloom.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + demo request (VP & CTO attendance?)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — I wanted to loop you in from TerraLoom. We're running a technology offsite next Thursday (8/17) and our CIO is driving a strategic review of our LLM roadmap. Our CTO (Maya Singh) and VP Product (Liam O'Rourke) are both being asked to attend a short product demo beforehand.

High level: we'd like a 45–60 minute walkthrough focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and private deployment options. Ideally both CTO and VP join; CIO may watch the recording but could join if timing works. Do you have availability next week?

Attendees (T-Loom):
 - Maya Singh, CTO
 - Liam O'Rourke, VP Product
 - Asha Patel, Head of Platform Strategy

Cc'ing our exec office to keep scheduling aligned.

Appreciate a few time options and an idea of the run of show so I can confirm internally.

Best,
Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Strategy | TerraLoom
asha.patel@terraloom.com
", "From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@terraloom.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request (VP & CTO attendance?)

Hi Asha — great to meet you virtually.

Thanks for the context. We can absolutely tailor a 45–60 minute session that focuses on the items you mentioned. Quick notes:
 - We recommend a 15-minute exec overview (ROI + risk controls), 25–30 minute demo focused on private/dedicated options and latency, then 10–15 for Q&A and next steps.
 - I attached a proposed run-of-show and a short attendee checklist to help you confirm what we should highlight.

Proposed windows (all PT):
 - Thu 8/17 — 11:00–12:00
 - Thu 8/17 — 15:00–16:00
 - Fri 8/18 — 09:00–10:00

Ben Carter (cc) is on the exec scheduling rotation; looping him for VP/CTO coverage and to confirm internal execs on our side.

If none of these work, tell me the best time block for Maya/Liam and we'll consolidate.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_run_of_show_v1.pdf (1 page)
", "From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request (VP & CTO attendance?)

Kim — quick internal note before we lock with Asha.

I can cover the 11:00 slot on 8/17 as the exec escort, but our VP Partnerships is traveling that afternoon. If TerraLoom strongly prefers an afternoon slot for their CIO to potentially join live, we should offer the 15:00 option as primary and confirm our CTO advocate (Jordan) to backstop if our VP can't make it.

Also: TerraLoom asked about private deployment specifics — do we want to include a 5-minute slide on our private controls and KMS/HSM integrations (security lead)? I can prep a single slide; keeps the technical Q&A focused.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
", "From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@terraloom.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request (VP & CTO attendance?)

Thanks Ben — helpful. Asha, quick update from our side:

We'd like to propose the Thu 8/17 15:00–16:00 PT window as the primary option so your CIO has the best chance to join. If that works, we'll plan:
 - 15:00–15:15 — Exec overview (Ben)
 - 15:15–15:40 — Live demo with latency/cost examples and private deployment sketch (Kim/Jordan)
 - 15:40–16:00 — Q&A and next steps (open)

Jordan Blake will be on the technical aisle for the demo and can dive into KMS/HSM and network topology questions. I attached the run-of-show again and included TerraLoom's attendee list (received from your office) so we can confirm names.

Could you confirm Maya and Liam for that window? If CIO needs a separate 20–30 minute prebrief with Ben, we can arrange that earlier the same day.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Attachments: redwood_run_of_show_v1.pdf, terraloom_attendee_list.xlsx
", "From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@terraloom.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: exec.office@terraloom.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request (VP & CTO attendance?)

Thanks Kimberly (and Ben) — quick update from our side.

Maya (CTO) and Liam (VP Product) are both available for Thu 8/17 15:00–16:00 PT — that works. Our CIO, however, is tied up with an executive offsite agenda and cannot make that slot. He asked if we can record and share the session and would like a 20–25 minute live prebrief on the same day at 09:30 PT (quick call with Ben if possible).

We confirm attendees from our side:
 - Maya Singh (CTO)
 - Liam O'Rourke (VP Product)
 - Asha Patel (Head of Platform Strategy)
 - +1 Product Ops (TBD)

I'll send a calendar hold once you confirm you can do the 09:30 prebrief with Ben. Also attaching our internal attendee list for reference.

Best,
Asha

Attachment: terraloom_attendee_list.xlsx
", "From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@terraloom.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request (VP & CTO attendance?)

Asha — perfect, thanks for confirming.

Ben can do the 09:30 prebrief with your CIO; Jordan and I will be on the 15:00 demo. We'll record and share post-session.

I'll send a calendar invite for both the 09:30 prebrief (private) and the 15:00 demo (all attendees) and include the run-of-show and slide for private deployment controls.

Quick asks before invites go out:
 - Confirm final +1 from Product Ops (name/email) so we can include in invite
 - Any specific latency/cost numbers you'd like us to model (e.g., typical sequence lengths / qps)?

Thanks again — looking forward to it.

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Related links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-terraloom-demo-20280815
"]
